blueprint.objective: Produce a reviewed management memo explaining quarterly revenue and cost performance by region from a synthetic financial dataset, with all figures traceable to computed statistics and qualitative context from optional business notes.

tasks.responsibility: Run the numeric-description tool over the financials CSV to obtain row count, the list of numeric columns, and per-column min/max/mean/sum. These figures are the sole source of truth for every number quoted in the memo.

If business_context is supplied, extract the key strategic themes and caveats that may explain regional performance differences. If business_context is absent, return empty lists so downstream tasks can proceed without it.

Using the computed statistics (compute_metrics) and the qualitative context (sector_context), plus the raw financials_csv for per-region detail, write a one-page management memo. The memo must explain revenue, cost, and margin for every region, cite the exact figures from the statistics, incorporate any themes/caveats, and list specific, actionable risks. A non-specialist manager should be able to read it without additional context.

tasks.role: Reviewer for Draft and review management memo
tasks.responsibility: Review the output of 'Draft and review management memo' against the rubric.

output_schema.name: approved
output_schema.description: True only if every criterion is met

output_schema.name: feedback
output_schema.description: Concrete revision instructions for the maker

patterns.rationale: 2 tasks have no dependency on each other; fan out and join at draft_memo
these tasks consume predecessor outputs; run in dependency order

rubric: Every numeric figure quoted in the memo matches a value produced by compute_metrics (stats) or is a transparently derived value (e.g. margin = revenue − cost) traceable to those figures.
Margin (revenue minus cost, or an equivalent ratio) is explicitly discussed for every region present in the dataset.
Each item in risks is specific (names a region, quarter, or metric) and actionable (states a recommended next step or threshold).
The memo is written in plain language suitable for a non-specialist manager; no unexplained jargon or raw CSV dumps.
If sector_context returned non-empty themes or caveats, they are referenced in the memo; if empty, the memo notes the absence of external context.

criteria: Every figure in the memo is traceable to the computed statistics or a transparent derivation thereof.
The memo is readable by a non-specialist manager without additional context.

missing_information: The PRD does not define the exact margin formula (absolute revenue − cost vs. percentage (revenue − cost)/revenue); the draft_memo task must pick one and state it, but the PRD should confirm the preferred definition.
The PRD does not specify a memo template, length limit in words, or required section headings beyond 'one-page'; a concrete template or word-count cap would reduce ambiguity.

The PRD does not state how to handle the case where business_context is omitted (skip sector_context entirely vs. emit empty lists); the task description assumes empty-list fallback but the PRD should confirm.

The PRD does not specify the expected number of regions or quarters, nor whether the dataset is guaranteed to contain all four quarters; edge-case handling (missing quarter, single region) is undefined.
No output file path or delivery format (Markdown, PDF, plain text) is specified for the final memo; the task currently returns a string but the PRD may require a written file via files.write_text.
